title: Shiprocket and Shopify Integration
seoTitle: Shiprocket Shopify Integration: Shipping and Tracking Sync
seoDescription: Connect Shopify to Shiprocket to create shipments, pick couriers, sync tracking and handle COD and returns. What is automatic, what needs custom rules.
summary: A Shiprocket–Shopify integration imports Shopify orders into Shiprocket, creates shipments with the chosen courier, and sends tracking numbers and delivery status back to Shopify so customers are notified automatically. Shiprocket offers a standard channel connection; custom work adds your own rules.

dataPoints.label: What syncs
dataPoints.value: Orders, weights and dimensions, tracking numbers, fulfilment status, COD remittance

dataPoints.label: Custom rules
dataPoints.value: Courier choice by pincode or weight, NDR handling, WhatsApp updates, returns flows

dataPoints.label: Accounting link
dataPoints.value: COD remittances and shipping charges can post to Tally

dataPoints.label: Typical effort
dataPoints.value: Hours for the standard channel; 1–3 weeks for custom rules

body:
## Beyond the standard channel

- Automatic courier selection based on cost and past delivery success by pincode.
- Non-delivery reports (NDR) sent to customers on WhatsApp to reattempt delivery.
- COD remittance reconciliation against orders.

See [delivery and logistics apps](/blog/delivery-and-logistics-apps-features-that-matter).

faqs.q: Do tracking updates reach customers automatically?
faqs.a: Yes, fulfilment with tracking syncs back to Shopify, which notifies customers; WhatsApp updates need an extra step.
Yes, Shiprocket supports return shipments; the refund in Shopify and accounts still needs a defined process.
